title: Microsoft Purview DLP: show remote machine information for file copies to Remote Desktop
notes: claim 55: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: The briefing is held because its impact rationale says the roadmap does not mention end users, although the description explicitly mentions an end-user file copy. The roadmap facts, licensing and audit controls otherwise check out; the RDP policy path and Windows Server qualification need small clarifications.

claims.claim: The printed Purview custom-policy path reaches Copy or move using RDP under Actions.
claims.quote: Select Full directory under Admin units. Scope the location to Devices only. Create a rule where: ... In Actions: Select Audit or restrict activities on devices. ... Select Apply restrictions to specific activity ... Copy or move using RDP
claims.fix: Expand controls[0].ui.path and its rendered copy to 'Data Loss Prevention > Policies > Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom policy > Admin units > Full directory > Devices > rule > Actions > Audit or restrict activities on devices > Apply restrictions to specific activity > Copy or move using RDP'. These are omitted headings and scope choices, not an incorrect printed step. Retain the note excluding the example's scan-failure condition. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-edlp-scan-fails.
